chunks: Aḥmad ibn al-Naḍr al-Khazzāz narrated from ʿAmr ibn Shimr, from Jābir, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: “Whoever is concluded with ‘There is no god but Allah’ enters Paradise; and whoever is concluded with the fasting of a day enters Paradise; and whoever is concluded with a charity by which he seeks the Face of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, enters Paradise.”

key_terms.الْجَنَّةَ: Paradise, the final abode of reward.
key_terms.بِصَدَقَةٍ: An act of charity given in the way of Allah.
key_terms.بِصِيَامِ يَوْمٍ: Ending one’s life while in the state of fasting for a day.
key_terms.لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ: The declaration of tawhid: there is no god but Allah.
key_terms.وَجْهَ اللَّهِ: Allah’s good pleasure and sake, indicating sincerity.

ai.seo_question: What deeds mentioned in hadith indicate a blessed end and entry into Paradise?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a good ending in speech and deed is a cause for entering Paradise. It highlights the salvific weight of tawhid, fasting, and sincere charity done purely for Allah, Mighty and Majestic.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5417 - Ahmad ibn Al-Nadr Al-Khazzaz narrated from Amr ibn Shimr from Jabir from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said that the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:

"Whoever's final words are 'La ilaha illa Allah (swt)' (There is no God but Allah (swt)) will enter Paradise.
Whoever's life ends while fasting for a day will enter Paradise.
And whoever's final deed is giving charity sincerely for the sake of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, will enter Paradise."
